title: Tarzan
identity_notes: Original American Gold Seal transcribed Tarzan serial distributed station-by-station. Historical run totals 286 installments; the frozen GRH snapshot contains surviving installments 1-77 with Los Angeles weekday-reference dates from September 12 through December 27, 1932.

eras.label: Tarzan of the Apes adaptation
eras.notes: First 130 installments adapt Tarzan of the Apes; local station schedules varied.

eras.label: The Return of Tarzan continuation
eras.notes: Remaining installments continue with a partial adaptation of The Return of Tarzan.

historical_context.title: Early transcription-disc syndication
historical_context.description: Tarzan was recorded for syndicated distribution on transcription discs, allowing stations in different markets to air the same installments on different dates.

historical_context.title: Print adventure franchise moves to radio
historical_context.description: The serial adapted Edgar Rice Burroughs’s established Tarzan novels into a continuing radio adventure.

historical_context.title: Signal Oil sponsorship and radio merchandising
historical_context.description: Signal Oil sponsored the West Coast serial and used the Tarzan property for extensive promotion.
